name: Hotel Garni Sonne
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Sonne is situated in a peaceful edge-of-village location in Neustift im Stubaital, framed by the peaks of the Stubai Alps. In winter, the renowned Stubai Glacier ski resort and the Elferbahnen lifts are easily reached, while summer opens up extensive alpine hiking trails across the valley. The bed-and-breakfast hotel features a hearty morning breakfast buffet, a restorative sauna area, and a quiet garden space for guest relaxation.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Sonne in Neustift im Stubaital provides quiet bed-and-breakfast accommodation, a sauna, a garden area, and proximity to the Stubai Glacier and hiking paths.
